headline: GIFT Nifty signals strong rebound as Indian markets reopen following sharp sell-off in banking and metals

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex shed 1,484 points led by profit-taking and heavy selling in banking and metal stocks after a four-week rally.
GIFT Nifty signals a strong rebound with analysts identifying 26,000 as a major hurdle to cross.
FIIs maintained their 16-session buying streak by investing ₹5,672.99 crore despite market decline.
Reports indicate the US is planning to hike tariffs on India and 15 other countries.
whatHappening: Tata Steel, NALCO, NLC India, Karur Vysya Bank, and Indian Bank are listed among stocks to watch today.
SpiceJet's daily flight services have shrunk to 20 per day as its operational fleet dropped to six.
Investors accumulated ₹34.61 trillion in wealth as the Sensex surged through November.
Viral posts point to potential fresh tech layoffs at major firms including Google and Microsoft in India.
summary: Indian share markets reopen today with GIFT Nifty pointing to a strong rebound after a sharp 1,484-point drop in the Sensex driven by profit-taking in banking and metals. Despite market volatility, FIIs extended their buying streak with ₹5,672.99 crore in net inflows. Individual stocks in focus include SpiceJet amid fleet reductions alongside Tata Steel, NALCO, and Indian Bank.
